errors.description: The double darts - the ONLY thing that distinguishes this option from its sibling 'Napoli without Dart' - are absent. The garment rendered is a clean dartless Napoli back, i.e. the sibling option. This is the sibling-collision failure: placed next to back-napoli-no-dart in the catalogue the two photographs are effectively indistinguishable, so a customer cannot tell the options apart.
errors.expected: Two shaping darts running vertically down the back below the yoke, one either side of centre, as drawn on the illustration.
errors.actual: No darts anywhere. Confirmed at magnification: the cloth rendered as a fine vertical stripe, and a dart in striped cloth produces an unmistakable stripe discontinuity where the intake is folded out - stripes step or converge across the seam. The stripes run unbroken and evenly spaced from the yoke seam all the way to the hem across the entire back panel. The two vertical light lines visible mid-back are specular fold highlights, not darts.

errors.description: The shirt is rendered in a fine blue vertical stripe. The illustration is a plain line flat with no stripe, and the other three back-style options in this same group render in plain white poplin, so a customer comparing back styles side by side sees a fabric change that is not part of the option.
errors.expected: Plain white cotton poplin, consistent with the rest of the Back Style option set, so nothing distracts from the construction being demonstrated.
errors.actual: Fine blue-on-white vertical stripe across the whole garment.

errors.description: The locked prompt for this option carries a GRAIN DIRECTION clause ordering a striped cloth with a diagonal stripe on the option's panel meeting straight stripes at a seam. That clause does not belong on a shirt back-yoke option and is the source of the striped fabric. The render also did not follow the diagonal half of the clause - every panel's stripe runs vertical - which is fortunate, since a diagonal panel would have contradicted the drawing outright.
errors.expected: Prompt text describing plain white poplin, as the other options in this group carry.
errors.actual: Prompt contains a grain-direction/diagonal-stripe fabric clause. Not fixable at this stage - the prompt is locked and must be used byte-for-byte - so this is flagged for the prompt builder upstream.

lockedFeatures: Napoli yoke: gathering/shirring released immediately below the yoke seam across the back width
two shaping darts below the yoke, one either side of centre
back view, straight yoke seam, curved shirttail hem
notes: Graded candidate-3 at magnification (2.6x yoke crop and two differently-exposed 2.1x mid-back crops). What IS correct: the Napoli yoke reads well - the stripes visibly pucker and gather along the full width immediately below the yoke seam, matching the fringe of shirring marks on the illustration. What is fatally wrong: the darts are missing, which collapses this option onto its sibling. I verified the absence rather than assuming it - striped cloth makes a dart conspicuous, and there is no stripe break anywhere on the back panel. Retry budget was already spent by a prior wave (attempt 3 on disk); this grading pass spent no credits, so no further attempt was made. This option needs a fresh attempt with a corrected prompt (plain poplin, darts called out explicitly) rather than another retry of the current one.
